title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Anthropic MCP update (Nov 24): Skills over MCP in public beta; Tasks and Elicitation now generally available; File Uploads coming soon
bullets.summary: MCP servers can now ship skills alongside their tools, long-running Tasks and mid-call Elicitation (the server asking the user a question) are GA, and file uploads over MCP are next.
bullets.how: The Construct: package our skills (b9-*, vironbox-*, hermes-*) with the MCP servers that use them, so any agent that connects gets both the tool and the instructions; use Tasks for long jobs (renders, partner orders) and Elicitation for owner sign-off. PRAGMA: a cleaner way to hand clients a tool and its playbook together.

bullets.title: Signal joins United Airlines and JPMorgan Chase in limiting AI agents on their services over customer risk (Nov 24)
bullets.summary: Large consumer brands are starting to restrict or block AI agents acting for customers on their services.
bullets.how: The Construct: Hermes/browser runners that sign in to third-party sites (partner portals, banks, airlines) should expect blocks and need a fallback to official APIs or a human step. Brand 9 Signs: decide on purpose whether the shop welcomes agent buyers. PRAGMA: an 'agent access policy' is now a real client question.

bullets.title: Mesh launches Mesh MCP (Nov 24): a hosted, read-only MCP server that lets coding agents build a payments integration from one prompt
bullets.summary: Works with Claude Code, Claude, Cursor and Codex; it reads docs and account setup but never moves funds.
bullets.how: Brand 9 Signs / The Construct: a model for how payment tooling should be exposed to agents (read-only by default, money moves only through a gated path); worth copying for Stripe and shop-order agents rather than adopting Mesh itself.

bullets.title: OpenAI rolls out a chat-tuned GPT-6.2 Sol in ChatGPT's Chat tab for paid tiers, including an offer to watch for price drops (Nov 24)
bullets.summary: OpenAI brings a chat-tuned version of its newest model to paid ChatGPT users, with shopping-style watch tasks built in.
bullets.how: Brand 9 Signs: ChatGPT is pushing deeper into shopping, so the AI-shopping work (product feeds, page facts) matters more. The Construct: re-run the weekly ChatGPT shopping prompt measure against the new default model.

bullets.title: Agent accountability and security money keeps flowing: Dante Security exits stealth with a $10M seed (NFX) and Metano raises $12M (Nov 24)
bullets.summary: Investors are funding tools that track and audit what AI agents do, as agents outpace existing security tools.
bullets.how: PRAGMA: agent audit trails are becoming a bought category, so lead client pitches with logging and accountability. The Construct: keep a per-agent action log as a standing requirement for every runner.

praxis_lesson: Two signals landed the same day: Anthropic made MCP able to carry skills and ask the user questions mid-task, while Signal, United and JPMorgan started limiting outside agents. The Construct should move its agents onto sanctioned MCP and API paths, with skills bundled and sign-off asked in-band, and treat scraping a site through a browser as a fallback that can stop working any day.
